answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial whose committed coefficients bind each Semaphore identity to a rate-limit secret. A zero-knowledge proof lets a message reveal only its epoch nullifier and polynomial share. Reusing that nullifier produces a second share; interpolation (Shamir secret sharing) exposes the private key, providing evidence for immediate collateral slashing. The jade delta kernel can verify the commitment and enforce the penalty without learning identities from ordinary messages.
